Shortlist Fastctx only if its documented purpose matches your use case; the source signals below are context, not an endorsement.

Best fit — and when to skip it

Fastctx is most relevant to developers working with Rust. It belongs on a shortlist when that stated purpose matches a concrete requirement.

Skip or postpone it when the documented runtime, license, dependency footprint, or maintenance model conflicts with your project. Popularity alone is not a reason to migrate.

Setup and first checks

Read the README, recent releases, issue tracker, security policy, and license before cloning Fastctx. Start in a disposable environment that matches your runtime and deployment constraints.

Bottom line
